name: opening_range_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's 15-minute opening range (09:15-09:30, 180 bars at 5s) is the price discovery phase where overnight FII positioning, SGX cues, and pre-market gap reactions are absorbed into the order book. When NIFTY breaches OR_high with the session VWAP already above the OR midpoint — confirming that the time-weighted institutional benchmark is net bullish — TWAP/VWAP algorithms holding back behind the range ceiling release queued directional orders, triggering a cascade of ORB-following algos in a 30-90 second burst of 15-40 spot points. The VWAP confirmation is the critical filter: breakouts where price is already above VWAP have genuine institutional buy-side bias behind them, while VWAP-below breakouts are more likely retail-driven spikes that fade within seconds.

indicators.name: or_high
indicators.formula: max(high) for bars where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: 15-minute OR is a FIXED TIME WINDOW (09:15-09:30 = 180 bars × 5s). Not scaled — the OR is always 15 minutes regardless of bar frequency. This is the exact window from the original strategy, preserved because institutional price discovery on NIFTY requires this full window on most sessions.

indicators.name: or_low
indicators.formula: min(low) for bars where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: Lower boundary of the 15-minute OR. Together with or_high defines the range that must be broken with conviction and VWAP confirmation.

indicators.name: or_vol_avg
indicators.formula: mean(volume) for bars where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: Average per-bar volume during the 15-minute OR window. Breakout volume must exceed 1.5x this average to confirm institutional order flow rather than retail noise.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume) from 09:15 reset each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from session open — no scaling needed, it is a cumulative measure. The original strategy requires close > VWAP for long entry and close < VWAP for short. This confirms institutional benchmark bias: VWAP-above breakouts have institutional accumulation behind them; VWAP-below breakouts are suspect.

indicators.name: vol_3
indicators.purpose: 15-second rolling volume average at time of signal. Smooths noisy 5-second NIFTY volume while remaining responsive. Compared against or_vol_avg to detect the volume surge that confirms institutional participation at breakout.

indicators.name: persist_above
indicators.purpose: 3-bar (15-second) persistence filter. At 5s resolution, single-bar spikes above OR_high are common noise. Three consecutive closes above the level confirms genuine breakout, replacing the original's 1-min bar body confirmation.

conditions: close > or_high for 3 consecutive bars (persist_above = True)
close > session_vwap (institutional benchmark is net bullish)
vol_3 > 1.5 * or_vol_avg (breakout volume elevated vs OR average)
India VIX < 22 (matches original threshold; ORB unreliable above 22)
or_range_pct between 0.1% and 2.0% (valid OR — not too tight or wide)
time_minutes in [570, 720) — after OR established, before 12:00 IST
buy_ce.confirmation: 3 consecutive 5s closes above or_high with VWAP above and volume surge

conditions: close < or_low for 3 consecutive bars (persist_below = True)
close < session_vwap (institutional benchmark is net bearish)
buy_pe.confirmation: 3 consecutive 5s closes below or_low with VWAP below and volume surge

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 NIFTY spot points at ATM delta ~0.5. The original stops at OR_midpoint (half the range, typically 10-30 spot points from entry). For a 90s hold, if NIFTY retraces 10 spot points back inside the OR, the institutional breakout has stalled — this is the classic ORB false-breakout failure mode. 5 pts option stop maps directly to this thesis.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points = ~16 NIFTY spot points. The original targets 1x OR_range from breakout level; with a typical OR of 30-80 spot points, that is 30-80 pts target. At 90 seconds, we capture only the first leg impulse — 16 spot points is the 25th percentile of first-leg ORB moves on NIFTY, achievable within the time stop window at a 1:1.6 R:R.
exit.eod_rule: no new signals after 12:00 IST; ORB momentum dissipates by midday

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 22; original uses VIX < 22. ORB false-breakout rate increases sharply above 22 as the opening range itself is noisy and institutional VWAP algos are less predictable.
filters.time_filter: entry only 09:30-12:00 IST; ORB momentum strongest in first 2.5 hours
filters.volume_filter: vol_3 > 1.5x or_vol_avg; replicates original's relative volume check, adjusted to 1.5x since 5s bars have higher per-bar volume noise than 1-min bars
filters.trend_filter: VWAP confirmation serves as directional filter (replaces original's nifty50 open return filter)

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — ORB is well-known but VWAP-filtered 5s execution at this granularity is not crowded; main risk is HFT competition for the breakout bar

adaptation_notes: The 15-min OR window (09:15-09:30, FIXED TIME WINDOW) is preserved exactly — not scaled. Key 5s adaptations: (1) 1-min bar body check replaced with 3-bar (15s) persistence filter — same purpose; (2) VWAP confirmation retained from original (close > VWAP for long) — this is the key differentiator from other ORB variants; (3) VIX threshold 22 preserved from original; (4) volume threshold reduced from 2x to 1.5x due to 5s bar noise; (5) hold time compressed from 30-120 min to 30-90 seconds — only the first impulse leg; (6) equity universe replaced with NIFTY index directly.
weaknesses: VWAP confirmation reduces signal frequency vs pure ORB — may miss some valid breakouts early in the session when VWAP hasn't yet diverged
False breakouts at 5s are more frequent than 1-min; 3-bar filter reduces but doesn't eliminate
NIFTY OR can be very narrow on low-event days (<20 pts), making 5pt stop too close to OR_mid
VIX < 22 filter blocks trading on high-vol days which sometimes have the strongest ORB moves
